ModMetaData.name: Date Night
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Adds Date and Lovin timetable slots to the Schedule tab.
Date hours: partners walk, sit at a table, or hang out. Mood and opinion only — no bed, no pregnancy.
Lovin hours: paint the same hours on both partners. They meet in a shared double. When both are in it, lovin uses a short mean-time-between until the schedule changes. The double is claimed for that window, then previous beds are restored.
Adults without a partner in that bed can have some private time in any bed (including a single). No pregnancy. Toggle it off in mod settings.
If Ideology forbids lovin, or Biotech sterile genes would make a forced lovin job pointless, Date Night reroutes to a date instead of forcing the job. Missing DLC fails open.
If a partner is drafted, in a medical bed, or off-map for the window, the one who showed up gets a short stood-up thought. If both make it, they get a small boost.
A schedule-mismatch alert fires when one lover has Date or Lovin painted and the other does not (or they painted different hours).
Works for no-sleep / low-rest pawns who never hit a Sleep block: Lovin still sends them to bed.
REQUIREMENTS - Date: love relationship, both scheduled Date, same map. Adults only. - Couples (Lovin): both scheduled Lovin, love relationship, shared double bed. - Private time: adult colonist, Lovin hours, a reachable bed. Children never qualify.
SETTINGS - Pregnancy-safe cooldown (default ON): keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown; only shortens the chance MTB while scheduled. - Eager mode (optional): also shortens post-lovin cooldown like Always Do Lovin — can spam pregnancy rolls. - Allow private time (default ON): self-lovin when a partner is not sharing a double. - Claim double for Lovin hours (default ON): temporary rendezvous bed, then restore.
Chinese Simplified and Russian included. Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: clear Date / Lovin schedule slots back to Sleep/Anything.
